title: The GMCP-013-06 latency budget must survive a loaded suite
goal: The merged GMCP-013-06 test asserts a 10 second per-request latency budget, which fails when the whole suite runs in parallel and spawns dozens of sessions: main went red after the merge while the test passes alone. Relax the budget to a value a loaded machine meets (60 seconds) so the test proves bounded behaviour instead of machine speed, keeping the typed-verdict and determinism assertions.
